item.caption: CT SHOULDER LEFT WO IV CONTRAST - Final result (09/02/2024 6:19 PM PDT)

paragraph.content: Displaced comminuted left humeral head and neck fracture with posterior dislocation of the humeral head fragment.
LEFT SHOULDER CT WITHOUT IV CONTRAST:
INDICATION: Status post trauma with pain.
TECHNIQUE: Axial images, along with reconstructed coronal and sagittal images were obtained through the left shoulder without intravenous contrast.

All CT is performed utilizing one of the following dose lowering techniques: automated exposure control, adjustment of the mA and/or kV according to patient size, and the use of iterative reconstruction technique.

FINDINGS: The alignment is satisfactory at the acromioclavicular joint. There is moderately displaced comminuted right humeral head and neck fracture with posterior dislocation of the left humeral head fragment with respect to glenoid. There is superior subluxation of the left humeral head. The scapula and clavicle are intact.
